source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Cloud Computing (PDF 111, printed 107).

blocks.text: Cloud computing aisi technology hai jo users ko apna data local computers ke bajaye door ke servers (remote servers) par store, manage aur process karne deti hai (Figure 8.4). Yeh servers internet par hote hain aur cloud service providers (cloud ki khidmat dene wali companies) inhein chalate hain. Is ka matlab hai ke users internet connection se kisi bhi waqt, kahin se bhi apna data aur applications khol sakte hain. Cloud ki wajah se taqatwar zaati computer ki zaroorat nahi rehti, kyunke zyada tar processing door ke servers par hoti hai.

Cloud computing se log aur karobar online services, jaise data storage, web hosting aur software applications, apna hardware rakhe baghair use kar sakte hain. Yeh streaming platforms, online learning systems aur mil kar kaam karne wali jagahon (collaborative workspaces) jaise jadeed digital tools chalati hai. Yeh technology bohat si rozmarra services ki bunyad (backbone) hai aur computing ko zyada lachakdar aur jura hua banati hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jab aap Google Drive ya iCloud par document save karte hain to asal mein aap Cloud Computing use kar rahe hote hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Cloud ka matlab aasman ka badal nahi: is ka matlab hai kisi company ke bare computers (servers) jo internet par hain. Aap apni file apne computer ke bajaye un servers par rakhte hain, aur phir mobile, laptop ya kisi bhi computer se internet ke zariye khol lete hain. Google Drive aur iCloud isi ki misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing mein data kahan store hota hai, aur is se taqatwar zaati computer ki zaroorat kyun kam ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Data local computer ke bajaye internet par maujood remote servers par store hota hai jinhein cloud service providers chalate hain. Zyada tar processing door ke servers par hoti hai, is liye apna taqatwar computer zaroori nahi rehta.

items: Cloud: remote servers par data store, manage aur process karna; internet se kahin bhi, kabhi bhi.
Storage, web hosting, software, streaming aur online learning ki bunyad (backbone).
